content: Joseph-el awayikw-rneman arrkerneyel
Joseph-el warrkenh-rnem ilek, “Yakweth-rnem-warl amern arriwek-atwety arrernerr-arey.
Man-anem yakweth ingwer-warl arenherr-arey irrkwa thilp-penh antywey-angker yanhan ayteyikw ikwerenh-rnem-kenh yakweth-warl arrerna.”
Ingwepenh artwernem tangkey-akert alhek.

Artwernem arrerenty-antey alpenh, Joseph-el warrkenh ikwerenh ilanthek, “Anterrkwetyek alha. Anterrkwentyelan renh-rnem ayernem, ‘Angwenhel irrkwa thilp-penh antywey-angker atyenh anyelkel inek irrtywerremel? Nhenh ikwerenh impen inngarl antywey-angker, akaltyiley-angker ikwerenh, ngangker-apeny. Arringkerr apmwel-areth mpwarek, ampwal atyenh anyelkel inerl-alhemel.’” Warrkenhel inngantey renh-rnem arey-alhek angath-antey alperl-anenty.
Ra renh-rnem ayernek Joseph-elarl renh ilek-angkwarr.
Awayenheng-rnem ilelhek, “Arrangkwarl anwingkerr, ampwal anyelk iney-angenh yanhan.
Anwingkerr man angkep antheynek Canaan-itwek.
Arentyelan irrkwa thilp-penh antywey-angker yakweth ingwerenty-kenh-itwek ntwa renh atwemarl. Ingwer-rneman anwingkerr warrkenh-anem ngkweng irrem-anem.”
Warrkenhel ilek, “Anyent ingweran atha aletharl anterrkwem, warrk ilkwa anthaynteyek. Ingwer-rnem atha tyarleweman.”
Awayenheng-rnem yakweth ikwerenh-rnem-kenh ahern-warl arrernek, altywerilemel.
Joseph-kenh warrkenhel yakweth-rnem areynek, arrwekeleny-they ingkern-penhek-atwety. Benjamin-kenh yakweth-itwek ra irrkwa thilp-penh antywey-angker ra renh arek, yakweth Benjamin-kenh-itwek.
Awayenheng-rnem Joseph-kenh apmer-warl alhek. Rernem Joseph-itwek kwenirrey-alhek.
Ra renh-rnem ayernek, “Ilekek arringkerr anyelkel inetyek arrkernelheyel, athan iterl-areyelarl?”

Judah angkek, “Ilek-angkwarr angketyek iterl-arey-angenh. Akngeyel lwewarrernek, anwingkerr apekarl apmwangkwarr mpwarek. Anwingkerr warrkenh ngkwenhan anayntem irrkwa thilp-penh antywey-angker anyelkel inek warrkenh inngan ngkwenh anayntem.”
Joseph-el renh-rnem ilek, “Athan nthakenh arrenhingkerr anterrkwey-angenharl. Anyent renh atha anterrkweman irrkwa thilp-penh ra anyelkel-inekant.”
Judah alhek Joseph-warl, angkey-alhek, “Ngan Atyetyart ilkwa Pharaoh-apeny. Anwekingkerr ahelirrey-angenh-antey.
Ntwa anwenhingkerr ayernek artwamp anwekingkerrenh iteth-antey anentyek aytey anwekingkerrenh apek anentyek. Anwingkerr ngenh ilek, aynaynwekingkerrenh artwa ampwanemanarl.
Artwa ampwantey ra anenh Benjamin ra atnyenek-angkwarr. Benjamin-kenh awayikw ilwek-anem. Artwa akely ra anyent impen-antey, ingwerarl ilwek-kety. Aynikw ikwer anyentekant arlkwenteyel.
Ntwa anwenhingkerr ilanthek, ‘Artwa akely akngetyay nhenh-warl, atha renh aretyek.’
Anwingkerr ngenh ilek, ‘Aynaynwekingkerrenh ilwemarl, Benjamin atwentyelan.’
Ntwa anwenhingkerr ilek, ‘Aytey arrekingkerrenh arrangkwelan, nthakenh arringkerr atyeng-warl apetyey-angenhan.’
Anwingkerr apmer-warl alpek artwamp anwekingkerrenh iley-alpek.
Artwampel anwenhingkerr ilanthek, ‘Ntang akngerr-antey inerl-alpetyek, apmer Egypt-itwek.’
Anwingkerr nthakenh Egypt-warl angkep alpey-angenh aytey anwekingkerr-wenyant. Atyetyartel anwenhingkerr irrenteyelantarl aytey anwekingkerr anwingkerr akngetyey-angenh-they.
Anewikw anyentel awey-atherr atnyenek rarl ikwer-atherrant ilkelhenh.
Anyent ywerrek aleth-antey arey-angenh apey-alpey-angenh.
Akngey anwekingkerrenh iterreyel atnwenth ahelengkwel artwa akely arlkwentyek-athen. Artwampel anwenhingkerr ilek, ‘Arringkerr artwa akely atyeng-they akngenty, ayeng ilwemarl-anem.’
Alakenhaym-kety artwamp anwekingkerr-warl anwingkerr artwa akely akngeynem.
Artwamp anwekingkerrenh ilweman artwa akely anwekingkerr-angkwarr apey-alpey-angenh-kety.
Atha artwamp renh ilek atha artwa akely renh apmer-warl iwerl-alhey-angenh. Atha artwamp renh ilek, ‘Atha artwa akely akngey-alpem. Arrangkwelan ntwa ayenh iterl-ara!’
Ayeng nhel anem ngkweng warrkirr-ayntetyek. Artwa akely yanhan alpeman artwamp ikwer ywarn iterrerl-anekerr Ayeng nthakenh alpey-angenh artwa akely iwerl-alhemel apmer nhenh-itwek.
Ayeng ilkelhey-angenh akngey atyenh atha aretyek amperrngirrenty artwa akely ikwer.”
